title: The Rain, 2000
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: New century. Same rain. Wood has stopped explaining it.

panels.composition: The beach in January rain. WOOD and BARNABY, small, walking the tide line. No dialogue.

image.prompt: a wide beach in heavy January rain, a young man and a small dog walking the tide line, dense vertical hatching, brush-pen black and white, no words

panels.composition: Closer. Still walking. Still no dialogue.

image.prompt: a young man with his coat over his head and a small dog shaking off water on a rainy beach, no words

panels.composition: The spruce grove at the beach's edge. Rain through it. The two of them at its foot.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog stopped at the foot of a dark spruce grove in rain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Same. The rain slightly less. That's the whole event.

image.prompt: the same spruce grove with the rain slightly thinner, two small figures at its foot, black and white, no words
image.notes: Four silent panels. The first fully silent daily. It ran on a Friday and half the digest's readers thought it was a printing error.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The first silent daily. The Rain no longer needs Bresson.
